ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent vulnerability discovery pipeline that uses adversarial LLMs to fuzz smart contracts and web apps, capturing flags automatically.
ideas.problem_statement: Cybersecurity competition involving penetration testing, vulnerability exploitation, and capturing hidden flags.
ideas.title: AgenticRedTeam
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the grand prize-winning pattern from SpectreRedTeaming by bringing agentic automation directly to security capture-the-flag competitions, appealing to security judges who value speed and automation.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge circuit verification suite designed to solve cryptographic challenges without revealing underlying private keys or plaintext flags.
ideas.problem_statement: Cybersecurity competition challenging participants across areas such as cryptography and reverse engineering.
ideas.title: CryptoZeroLeak
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the cryptography and reverse engineering challenge domains with advanced ZK tooling, matching the technical depth seen in winning ZK hackathon projects like openstoa.

ideas.pitch: A real-time network traffic topology mapper and attack simulation visualizer for identifying hidden intrusion vectors during live red-team engagements.
ideas.problem_statement: Cybersecurity competition involving practical security challenges in a simulated real-world environment.
ideas.title: GraphGuard-CTF
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements complex graph intelligence and visualization inspired by A10 Networks Hackathon winner GraphGuard, providing a visually striking interface for complex security data.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight automated binary disassembly and decompilation triage assistant that surfaces hidden strings and vulnerability vectors for reverse engineering challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: The competition will challenge participants across areas such as penetration testing, reverse engineering, cryptography, and vulnerability exploitation.
ideas.title: BinaryScope
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact bottleneck of reverse engineering challenges by combining static analysis parsers with local LLM assistance, showcasing genuinely hard engineering in a tight timeframe.

ideas.pitch: A secure biometric-authenticated credential and flag storage vault utilizing client-side zero-knowledge encryption to securely manage and submit CTF flags.
ideas.problem_statement: Identify vulnerabilities, apply technical problem-solving skills, and capture hidden flags to score points.
ideas.title: FlagVault
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates exceptional polish and military-grade privacy similar to CyberVault, providing a robust utility tool for competitors to track and secure their captured flags.
